title: Foreign Study Scholarship (8842)
eligibility: Applicant must be a Madhya Pradesh domicile
Age must be up to 35 years as of 1 January
Annual family income limit stated by the official record: INR 10 lakh
For postgraduate study: bachelor's final examination with at least 55%
For PhD: postgraduate examination with at least 50%
benefits: Annual tuition support up to USD 40,000
Visa fee, insurance, poll tax, airfare and eligible rail/bus fare support as stated in the official record
documents_required: Documents are not enumerated in the retrieved official record
application_process: Contact Tribal Affairs Department headquarters, Bhopal
important_sections_or_clauses: The official record states the scholarship is for postgraduate and higher-level degrees.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
